title: [Main] -Drop shipment undo receipt fails for service and non-inventory items.
summary: Undo receipt and undo shipment operations now work correctly for drop shipments involving service and non-inventory items by removing unnecessary cost application filters and adding a fallback lookup method through drop shipment links.
key_points: Removed 'Cost Application' filter from drop shipment application entry lookup to include cost-less entries for non-inventoriable items
Added null check when finding item application entries to skip missing records instead of erroring
Implemented fallback method to locate sales shipment lines through drop shipment document links when item ledger entry path fails
Enables both undo shipment and undo receipt operations to complete successfully for service and non-inventory drop shipments
quote: Drop shipment undo receipt fails for service and non-inventory items.
